Hahns Rives is a Black Gauntlet of Bane who oversees the Steel Watch Foundry's underground lab area. He is at X: -1957 Y: 454.
“
"We seek a realm without conflict, without ego, without free will. We seek unity. We seek the Ultimate State."
„
— Hahns Rives

Involvement

Hahns Rives is the Black Gauntlet of the Foundry Lab Level in the Steel Watch Foundry. He is in charge of overseeing the Foundry's operations, and ordering and controlling the Gondian workers.[1] Hans was also in charge of sourcing a vessel and pilot,  Redhammer, for transporting Gondian hostages to the Iron Throne.[2] Previously a research facility for the Steel Watchers, the Iron Throne was converted into a prison, mainly to contain the hostages. [3]

With the production of Gortash's Steel Watchers reaching completion, Rives was ordered to begin winding down operations in the Foundry and executing any Gondians who proved difficult.[4] Hahns also recieved orders from  Enver Gortash, which he dispersed to the other Banites, to sweep the Iron Throne and dispose of any leftover technical prototypes and experiment logs. With the Gondian workers no longer needed, they were ordered to dispose of the remaining hostages as well.
